title: DCT MCP Server: assistant does not treat "compliance node" as a Continuous Compliance engine

acceptance_criteria.text: Prompt "Which compliance node is registered in DCT?" (and the same with "masking engine") returns Continuous Compliance engines and does not say "node" or "Masking Engine" back to the user.
Asking how to use a compliance engine produces the agreed two-approach explanation.
Regression test fails if the alias is removed.

constraints.text: The two approaches for using a compliance engine still need to be defined by the feature owner — this is an open question that must be resolved before AC-2 can be completed.
The 'Rules (read first)' block in server_instructions.md must remain within the first 4,000 characters after any addition.
A regression test must be added in tests/unit/test_vocabulary_regression.py that fails if the 'compliance node' alias is removed.
